events.verdict: Camara (POR) establishes himself in Payton II's (GSW) path prior to the contact.
Curry (GSW) rests an arm against Avdija (POR) and maintains it as he enters his shooting motion. Green (GSW) then jumps vertically and absorbs the ensuing contact with Avdija.
Green (GSW) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Camara (POR) maintains a legal guarding position as he moves alongside of Curry's (GSW) path to the basket.
Podziemski (GSW) moves laterally into Camara (POR), but the contact as they come together is marginal.
Camara (POR) briefly brings an arm around Podziemski (GSW) as he loses control of his dribble. After regaining possession of the ball, the ensuing contact is marginal.
Butler III (GSW) directly contests Love's (POR) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Love's hand after the release.
Williams III (POR) extends an arm in Butler III's (GSW) path and the contact is marginal.
Grant (POR) does not release the shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Butler III (GSW) is already in Camara's (POR) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Avdija (POR) blocks Butler III's (GSW) shot attempt near the rim.
Camara (POR) initiates body contact with Butler III (GSW) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Butler III (GSW) establishes himself in Camara's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Camara (GSW) bobbles the ball and maintains his pivot foot upon regaining possession.
Moody (GSW) commits a take foul on Avdija (POR).
Grant (POR) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
